people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Cyrus
people.line: Persian Emperor who decreed the rebuilding of the Temple

translations.web: But in the first year of Cyrus king of Babylon, Cyrus the king made a decree to build this house of God.
translations.bsb: In the first year of his reign, however, Cyrus king of Babylon issued a decree to rebuild this house of God.
translations.kjv: But in the first year of Cyrus the king of Babylon the same king Cyrus made a decree to build this house of God.
translations.asv: But in the first year of Cyrus king of Babylon, Cyrus the king made a decree to build this house of God.
